name: firefox-courier-new
note: Non-trivial fallback through the FIREFOX fallback table at layout time: the stack 'Courier New' resolves to the registered Source Code Pro face (firefox.ts fallback 'Courier New' -> 'Source Code Pro'), and the block text wraps/paints with that face — exactly matching Firefox's Gecko resolution of 'Courier New' on this system. This is the cross-family LAYOUT fixture that lands on Source Code Pro via the firefox table.
